flags.name: Broccolini
flags.issue: IDENTITY — one supplier code, two different vegetables. Across the 52 FFT invoices in the corpus, code 'BRL'/'BRL Box' is printed as 'Broccolini' (3 invoices, $31.20-$36.00/box), as 'Radiccio' (INB00109847, $28.80/box), and as the bare code 'BRL Box' with no product name at all (9 invoices). The feed resolves the whole code to Broccolini at $33.60/box, so the Radiccio delivery is costed as broccolini and any bare 'BRL Box' line inherits whichever won.
flags.suggested_fix: Ask FFT what BRL actually is. If it is genuinely two products they need two codes; if Radiccio was a keying error on INB00109847, correct that invoice. Until then treat BRL costs as approximate. Do not merge silently.
